currencies.long_description: Credits are earned during a run through kills and support effects. They are intentionally temporary and are spent only by future in-run shop systems.

currencies.short_description: Persistent currency for tower and module upgrades.
currencies.long_description: Core Parts come from completed runs and milestones, then fund modest permanent progression in the Workshop without replacing build choices.

currencies.short_description: Cosmetic currency for skins and presentation unlocks.
currencies.long_description: Shards are earned from runs and Daily Challenges. They unlock cosmetic options and never increase combat power.

currencies.short_description: Rare currency for transformative ultimate evolutions.
currencies.long_description: Legend Cores are earned from first-clear Dailies and major milestones. They buy mutually exclusive Legendary Evolutions that specialize an ultimate instead of adding a linear damage tier.
